parameters.query:
SELECT a.due_at, a.end_at
FROM calendar_integrations ci
LEFT JOIN activities a ON a.user_id = ci.owner_user_id AND a.due_at::date = $1::date
WHERE ci.is_active = true
ORDER BY ci.created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
WITH found_contact AS (
  SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE ($1::text IS NOT NULL AND phone = $1) OR ($2::text IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(email) = LOWER($2)) LIMIT 1
),
new_contact AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (first_name, last_name, phone, email, lead_source, owner_id, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT $3, $4, $1, $2, 'Phone Booking', $5, now(), now()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found_contact)
  RETURNING id
),
resolved_contact AS (
  SELECT id FROM found_contact UNION ALL SELECT id FROM new_contact LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO activities (contact_id, user_id, type, subject, due_at, end_at, google_event_id, created_at)
SELECT rc.id, $5, 'meeting', $6, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, $9, now()
FROM resolved_contact rc
RETURNING id;
